metadata.title: Between the Rounds: Estimating how Brazilian voters moved from the first to the second round of the 2026 presidential election
metadata.description:
This working paper presents an exploratory reconstruction of vote transfers between the two rounds of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election using ballot-box-level aggregate results and ecological inference.

It describes data matching, a Brown–Payne-style transition model, reconciliation through iterative proportional fitting, registration-movement sensitivity analyses, bootstrap uncertainty, simulation-based validation, and comparisons with opinion polls. It emphasizes ecological bias, the limitations of model-based uncertainty, and the distinction between estimated aggregate transitions and observed individual behavior.

This record contains English and Portuguese PDF editions of version 1.0. Interactive figures and the complete reading experience are available on the author’s website.
metadata.notes: Exploratory working paper, not a peer-reviewed article. English and Portuguese editions are included in a single record. The reported uncertainty does not capture all uncertainty about modeling assumptions.
